reviews.t: THE BEST DETANGLER BRUSHES I EVER BOUGHT FOR MY WIFE!!!!
reviews.x: My wife cannot thank me enough for these Detangler Brushes I bought for her! Having natural curly hair, she says she sometimes want to wear her hair straight and not a single brush has ever worked like these two brushes! I took a chance and bought it for her birthday! She says that they have been one of the best presents she had ever received and she thought the brushes were really expensive because on how well they work. She says that she is going to recommend these brushes to her friends.

The design of this brush is great, and actually gets through my thick mane of long hair without being a nightmare on my tender head. That said, in no universe do I believe these are natural boar bristles. They’re definitely some kind of little black plastic or nylon bristles perhaps meant to mimic boar, but is just not the same when it comes to distributing the natural oils through from the scalp to the ends of the hair. I’m disappointed because that was the entire reason I ordered them; not so

I am so pleasantly surprised by these brushes!  They instantly became a family favorite, and my daughter, who has the knottiest hair, threw away all of her wet brushes and immediately switched to this brush!  It goes through every layer of her hair and doesn't HURT!!! We are so happy with this, and have even convinced others to buy it already!

I brought this brush set to use with my FHI blow dryer, while doing blow outs on my 3B/3C hair. Works perfectly! Glides smoothly through, without any snags or pulls to my hair. I have experienced minimum heat damaged to brush bristles from the heat of the blow dryer.

Finally after 34 years I’ve found a brush that will actually brush my hair through and not yank out a bunch of hair and doesn’t make me dread the brushing process . Great for people with frizzy curly hair . I even gifted one to my best friend because she thought it was completely amazing .

reviews.t: My girls are happy with it
reviews.x: My girls love their brush and better at not so painful detangler. Worth it!

reviews.t: Great but not for blow drying
reviews.x: I wanted a brush that would work for my thick, long hair without breaking it. I never had a boar bristles brush before. I do really like these brushes. The handle is slightly flexible and when you brush your hair, it feels like a little massage. The brush pulls out less hair than a regular paddle brush and it works great if my hair is completely wet or dry. However, it isn't the best for blow drying my hair. At the scalp, when blow drying, it has too much flexibility and doesn't really get in th
Very good brush for long hair - gently detangles, doesn’t pull hair, nice quality and the handle. Don’t need to pay for similar overpriced ones.
Love how this brush curves with you head. Brush more hair in one stroke. The metal tag on the handle falls off.

These are the best hairbrushes I’ve ever used. I have everything from the wildly expensive Mason Pearson, brushes from high-end hair product companies, brushes from the drugstore and from the salon. Dozens and dozens of brushes in my endless quest for a brush I really like. Those can all go in the trash.  My hair is shoulder length, fine, but very thick & wavy. It’s hard to get any brush through it, especially in the back/nape. This brush is curved and gets right up snug against my scalp, catche

reviews.t: ok soooooo i love this brush
reviews.x: So i have curly hair and lately since quarantine its been shedding more than usual, so i decided to throw away all the products i was using including my brush, i ordered these with my fingers crossed that it works as good as it says in the reviews and today i used it for the first time and thank you Jesus ! it slid through my hair and i had very minimal shedding !! i am so happy with these brushes and hello u get 2 for $5.88!!! if you have super knotted hair like me and you shed alot, get these

I run a day care and have about 20 minutes to brush through 4 girls hair to get ready for school. These brushes will go through bed heads, curly tangled hair, hair with food stuck in it etc in minutes. It has saved me so much time and the little girls are no longer complaining that the brush is pulling their hair. (yes I was gentle lol!) I also have waist length hair and I use one. It doesn't pull my hair and I have less hair in my brush when I am done. I love these brushes!

I got this brush because my 11 year old daughter has very think and long hair along with a tender head.  We have purchased so many different brushes in her lifetime trying to find one that does not pull and gets out tangles that she likes.  Well this is the best one we have found so far.  The bristles on this one are long enough through most of her hair.  It does not pull as much and we have less drama over getting her hair brushed.

reviews.t: Love these brushes and the price!
reviews.x: You can not beat this set. These brushes are amazing. They are perfect for every persons hair in my family, from thin baby hair to thick curly hair. The brush has two sets and sizes of bristles they get even the smallest little knots out. Don’t hesitate purchasing these. You will not regret.

reviews.t: Great for thick curly long hair.
reviews.x: I have very thick curly long hair. I love these brushes. I recently used one of my older brushes and realized how great these brushes are.  I've been using them for over 6 months. I will definitely get new ones when these die out.  But they are still going strong.

I have long hair that can get tangled easily. I really like this brush because it conforms nicely to my head and brushes through my hair nicely. I like the boar bristles with the vent bristles. It is a great brush and I would definitely by it again!

Bought these, the cheaper version, to try and see if I like them before I buy the more expensive ones. I really do like them but I'm constantly pulling the loose bristles out of my hair.  Hopefully, the more expensive version doesn't do that.

Skeptical due to the low price tag for two brushes, but I can honestly say these are the best at detangling thick curly hair when it’s wet without pulling it or causing breakage. Will definitely buy more when these need to be replaced.

If you are biker.. this is a must have! I ride without a helmet and my long hair gets a tangled mess. I let it settle for a while and this brush goes right through without tearing my hair out at the root or breaking it off.

I have straight, fine, but thick hair, and this brush does an incredible job helping smooth and dry my hair. The curve in the brush also makes it seem super comfortable on my scalp. Definitely a good purchase.

I purchased a brush like these several years ago and love it.  I have used it daily.  I just received these and haven't had time to judge.  The tips of the bristles are not as cushioned as my previous one.

reviews.t: Great brush for kids who don’t like having their hair brushed!
reviews.x: This brush is awesome! My girls hate having there hair brushed but this brush easily takes out the tangles without yanking on the hair. I highly recommend this brush. Good for thick or fine hair!
Not read boar bristles but I already expected that for having a very cheap price. Brushes feels good on the head because of the vented pad, and the bristles do not come off easily. Good product!
Can’t beat the price! My daughter has really long hair and bath time is never fun combing hair for long time and hearing ouch this brush causes the least “ouches” from my kiddo!
Very nice and feels good.  Gave one to son for his long curly hair and kept one for my long straight hair.  Works great on  both.  De-tangles and feels like a scalp massage.

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise these brushes for gently detangling thick, curly, and knotty hair without pulling or causing pain.
Many customers say the brushes work well for the whole family, from children with tender heads to adults with various hair types.
Several reviewers question whether the bristles are actually natural boar bristles, suspecting they are plastic or nylon.
Some reviewers note durability and value, saying the brushes hold up over time and are cheaper than comparable overpriced brands.
A few reviewers mention minor issues like the metal tag falling off the handle or limited suitability for blow drying.
